caption: The drawing shows a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a trivet or stand made of dark, possibly metallic material. It has an overall teardrop or shield-like shape with a sturdy, thickly twisted border that resembles rope. At the center is an oval plate bordered by a raised rim, also in a dark color. Inside the upper section of the frame are symmetrical spiral and looped elements, forming a decorative pattern, while the bottom part of the object is a single looped handle, similarly textured with the rope-like design. The trivet rests on three small, stubby legs that lift it slightly above the surface. The artist's signature, "Syd R. Prosser," is present just below the object, on the right side of the image.
title: Trivet
